benchmarks.harness: Med-De-Anamnese, 4 simulated doctor-patient dialogues from public videos, small set (paper, January 2026)

strengths: Most widely deployed, 99 languages, many fine-tunes (e.g. primeline German, 27k downloads)
weaknesses: Hallucination and repetition, especially on silence
No longer the accuracy leader (German avg 3.64 vs 2.95 for primeline-parakeet)

tona_fit.reason: Fallback and languages outside the 25 European ones; MIT, 99 languages, mature on AMD and Mac. On German the turbo is clearly weaker than large-v3 (6.12 vs 4.00) and than the newer models; prefer a Parakeet/Qwen/Cohere class model or the primeline German fine-tune.
